schema.description: One pathology request as a lab reported it: the header facts of one draw's report section, read into a records file. Written by scripts/extract-acl-pathology.py for Australian Clinical Labs PDFs and by hand readings of other reports. Text is as printed unless a field says the extraction reformatted it.

clinical_notes.description: The request's clinical notes as printed on the report, verbatim. Hand readings only; the script does not read it.

collected.description: When the sample was drawn, the report's COLLECTED field, reformatted by the extraction from DD/MM/YY to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in Sydney local time. A draw with no printed time takes one from the extractor's --known-times, or 00:00. This is the fact time.

comment.description: The lab's comment for this draw, as printed below the results, with line breaks and runs of spaces collapsed to single spaces by the extraction.

fasting.description: Whether the report says the patient fasted. Derived by the extraction from the printed "Fasting status" line (the script) or read from the report (hand readings); absent when the report says nothing.

id.description: Identity, chosen at extraction and deterministic from the content: the lab's prefix, the lab number, "panel", and the panel name as a slug.

lab.description: The lab that did the work. The script writes "Australian Clinical Labs" for every record, a constant rather than text read from the report; hand readings write the lab's name as the report gives it.

lab_number.description: The lab's number for this draw, as printed (7 or 8 digits), kept as text. One draw is one collection event, shared by the panel and its results.

lab_ref.description: The report's lab reference header field, as printed ("Lab REF" on current Australian Clinical Labs reports, "Lab Reference" on older ones): two-digit year, lab number, the lab's code for the test (the same codes as the report's test-status line) and a trailing digit whose meaning the report does not state. The script takes the lab number from its second part.

note.description: A note by whoever read the report, saying what the reading settled or doubted (a misprinted date, which page decided it). Not report text.

panel.description: The panel heading as printed above the result table, in the report's capitals.

reported.description: When the lab reported, the report's REPORTED field, reformatted by the extraction to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

reported_by.description: The doctor named on the report's "REPORTED BY" line at the end of a section, as printed with "Dr." written "Dr". Seen on an ECG section; hand readings only.

requested.description: The date the test was requested, the report's REFERRED field, reformatted by the extraction to YYYY-MM-DD.

requested_by.description: The requesting doctor as printed on the report. Hand readings only.

section.description: The discipline heading printed above the panel heading (such as BIOCHEMISTRY or CARDIOLOGY), as printed. The script reads past these words and never writes it; hand readings have written it once, though reports print it above most panels.

specimen.description: The specimen as printed after "SPECIMEN:", in the report's capitals.

your_reference.description: The report's "Your Reference" header field, as printed: the addressee's own reference for the request, the same on every panel of a draw. The report does not say what it numbers. Hand readings only, and only where a reader took it; many reports print it blank.
